card.name: Given names before a surname
card.fires_on: Responds to a first name or title (Robert, John) or the start of a surname right after it, mainly in historical or reference text, where the surname is about to come next.

modes.label: Robert before a surname
modes.description: The first name Robert comes just before a surname, including the publisher Robert Appleton.

modes.label: Inside a surname
modes.description: A partial surname after a first name, where the rest of the name follows.

modes.label: Name before a title
modes.description: A first name or title in a church or formal name sequence.
modes.example: Imprimatur. +John<< Cardinal>> Farley, Archbishop of New York.
